taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1426 | 2.2 | 2.2
2 | 569 | 0.998 | 3.2
3 | 1241 | 23.2 | 26.4
4 | 1931 | 30.1 | 56.5
5 | 2994 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA
Aquifer depth: 26.4 – 56.5 m
Recommendation: Target the thick, highly resistive sand layer between 26.4 m and 56.5 m for screen placement, as it offers the best combination of thickness and resistivity for a productive aquifer; confirm lithology with drill cuttings before finalizing screen depth, and be prepared to case off the shallow low-resistivity (clayey) zone above 3.2 m.
